description: This file defines the UninterruptibleThread class, a custom thread implementation that provides a mechanism to run code uninterruptibly and manage thread interruption behavior in a controlled manner within the Apache Spark project.

classes.name: UninterruptibleThread
classes.description: A specialized Thread class that allows running code uninterruptibly by deferring interruption signals until it is safe to process them.

methods.name: runUninterruptibly
methods.description: Runs a given block of code in the thread, ensuring it is not interrupted during execution.

methods.name: interrupt
methods.description: Overrides the default interrupt method to defer interruption if the thread is in an uninterruptible state.
